summary_en: SUPER TOOL will acquire up to 30,000 shares (1.27% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥60 million through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between October 21, 2026 and April 20, 2027, to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Pertaining to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
SUPER TOOL's Board of Directors resolved on October 20, 2026 to acquire treasury stock as follows: up to 30,000 shares for a maximum of ¥60 million through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition period runs from October 21, 2026 through April 20, 2027. The target shares represent 1.3% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), calculated on a base of 2,365,478 shares as of October 19, 2026.

The company stated that the acquisition is intended to strengthen shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency while maintaining flexibility for future capital policy decisions. The maximum acquisition price of ¥60 million implies an upper price limit of approximately ¥2,000 per share.
